limits: Retrospective after multiple previous strategy searches; not independent confirmation.
Training target uses midnight daily opens and adverse daily funding marks; execution delayed to 01:00.
Unavailable full cross-section weeks are omitted only when training after their end; no imputed delisting price.
selection_scope: Highest-return trading variant on development, for comparison only; not authorization to trade.

limits: Assumes the published general settlement rule applied without an exceptional override.
Index candle extrema must cover the settlement rule's secondwise samples.
A bounded accounting scenario is not an observed settlement transaction.
settlement_evidence.method: Bounds on equally weighted 1800-second index average from 30 one-minute OHLC ranges.

limits: Centered circular moving-block bootstrap; finite-sample approximation.
Adjustment covers only the supplied family, not every prior research trial.
No risk-free yield, live fills, delisting uncertainty or structural breaks are resolved by a p-value.
